about: Questions whose answer needs more than one file, of different kinds, on one shelf (D-169). The files are made up by the team: the recordings with Windows' speech synthesis, the images drawn. Each entry in parts is one thing the answer must hold, in any of the forms given, and the file it comes from. Too few and too clean to be a measure of quality: they show whether a combined answer works at all.
